name: Golden Throne
description: Sacred geometry mandala with golden ratio spirals and counter-rotating layers.

name: Neon Drip
description: Metaball blobs dripping upward with surface tension physics and trailing tendrils.

name: Moonlit Ripple
description: Moon reflection on dark water with multi-directional waves, Fresnel reflection, and 3D perspective.

name: Eclipse Glow
description: Solar eclipse corona with radial noise rays, diamond ring effect, and streaming solar wind.

name: Diamond Caustics
description: Light refracting through rotating diamond facets casting prismatic caustic patterns.

name: Metamorphosis
description: Raymarched metaballs continuously merging and splitting with liquid-metal surface.

name: Silk Groove
description: Flowing silk ribbons with specular highlights and cloth-like wave animation.

name: Event Horizon
description: Physics-based black hole with raytraced gravitational lensing, volumetric accretion disk, and Doppler beaming.

name: Vertigo
description: Slow hypnotic tunnel with crimson ring segments, wave-based illumination, and dark void center.

name: Silk Cascade
description: Flowing layered silk fabric with anisotropic specular highlights, parallax depth, and warm translucent overlap.

name: Smolder
description: Radial warmth radiating through animated turbulence with heat shimmer, ember particles, and cool blue edges.

name: Magma Core
description: Volcanic eruption with thermal lava particles, cooling physics, and magma pool.

name: Shifting Veils
description: Layered translucent noise curtains that morph and reveal patterns underneath.

name: Kaleidoscope Runway
description: Fashion-inspired kaleidoscopic tessellations with symmetric mirror segments.

name: Neon Drive
description: Rain-slicked neon road stretching to a vanishing point with approaching headlights.

name: Liquid Gold
description: Molten metal flow with surface tension, metallic PBR shading, and golden reflections.

name: Aurora Veil
description: Northern lights ribbons flowing above hexagonal ice crystal formations.

name: Bioluminescence
description: Deep sea jellyfish pulsing with bioluminescent glow and drifting plankton.

name: Gothic Filigree
description: Ornate fractal lace scrollwork growing from corners with dark metallic rendering.

name: Thunder Sermon
description: Fractal lightning bolts with Lichtenberg branching and thunder shockwaves.

name: Vinyl Grooves
description: Spinning vinyl record with visible grooves, tonearm, and needle spark.

name: Polaroid Burn
description: Scattered polaroid photos developing warm abstract memories, overexposing, and burning out with ember edges.

name: Scream Wave
description: Glowing waveform building from gentle sine to distorted scream with chromatic aberration and collapse.

description: Overlapping concentric ring patterns creating hypnotic emergent moiré interference in blue-violet and teal.

name: Magnetic Field
description: Dipole field lines curving between slowly rotating poles with silk-thread glow rendering.

name: Aurora Curtain
description: Vertical luminous threads swaying like aurora borealis curtains with warm-to-cool color gradient.

name: Vortex
description: Logarithmic spiral arms converging on a drifting center with silk-thread glow and undulating perturbation.

name: Lens Whisper
description: Anamorphic lens flares with chromatic color separation, horizontal streaks, bokeh halos, and cinematic film grain on pure black.

name: Painted Strata

name: Dither Gradient
